pm-agent.description: Use when triaging GitHub issues, assigning role labels, decomposing vague requests, and coordinating delegated worktrees.

dev-agent.description: Use when implementing an approved GitHub issue in a delegated worktree.

frontend-test-agent.description: Use when running frontend tests, capturing screenshots, or posting validation reports to a GitHub issue.

refactor-agent.description: Use when simplifying architecture, docs, or tests with fail-fast and low-complexity refactors.

merge-integrator.description: Use when validating a delegated branch, squash-merging it to main, and cleaning up its worktree.

docs-maintainer.description: Use when updating README, AGENTS.md, or policy docs to match implemented behavior.
